title: Honeycomb & Yogurt
desc: Smooth, chalky alabaster surfaces bathe in warm morning light filtering from a sunlit kitchen window. A rustic chunk of raw golden honeycomb rests on thick, velvety Greek yogurt inside an artisanal ceramic bowl, its amber hexagonal cells glistening under low directional side-light as a heavy, viscous drip slowly folds into the matte white surface.
businessBrief: The organic interplay of rustic textures, natural directional light, and the slow pour dynamics of fresh cream establishes an authentic farm-to-table luxury mood. Designed for heritage culinary brands, organic CPG producers, and seasonal restaurant campaigns.
